title: Act on the Change of the Name of Nam-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City
title_original: 인천광역시 남구 명칭 변경에 관한 법률
full_text:
The name "Nam-gu (南區)" in Incheon Metropolitan City shall be changed to "Michuhol-gu (彌鄒忽區)".

ADDENDA <Act No. 15499, March 20, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on July 1, 2018.

Article 2 (Relationship with Other Statutes) Where any other statute or regulation in force at the time this Act enters into force cites "Nam-gu" of Incheon Metropolitan City, whose name is changed under this Act, such citation shall be deemed a citation of "Michuhol-gu" under this Act.

metadata.completion_statement: The complete one-line main provision and both Articles of the Addenda of KR:013096 have been included in English, reusing the two existing partial English units.
